preserveReasons.set-up_y2: Structural second-year festival map, actor, animation and control command script; preserved byte-for-byte.

corrections: Translated and reread all quoted player-facing lines in the first- and second-year soup ceremony and all seven governor-reaction event scripts directly from English.

Preserved the second-year set-up script byte-for-byte, every event command and every dialogue, emotion, numeric and stage-direction marker, with target-specific quoted-field and command-skeleton validation.
Applied locked Луау and Губернатор terminology, kept repeated ending messages identical, and refined the disgust interjection and group praise into natural Bulgarian.
